$comment: Curation manifest for the lib's EXPORTED DS lego-block components. Keyed by catalog id (the kebab-cased story title). Each entry enriches the generated catalog item with an import statement + props (read from the colocated *.props.json the story also renders), usage guidance, key brand tokens, and end-to-end examples whose full source is embedded verbatim (with the examples/_lib shim rewritten to the package name). Paths are relative to packages/ds-patternfly. Examples are also auto-discovered by story↔example path mirroring, so most entries only need propsFile + usage.

ai-chat.usage: AiAssistant is the lib's exported AI chat experience: a brandable prompt bar that renders inline wherever you place it, plus the surfaces it grows into — a transient recent-chat popover and a repositionable, resizable, searchable full-conversation panel (a modal below the sm breakpoint). Overlays portal into the `overlayContainer` element (position: relative) and anchor to its corners. Wire your backend via `onSend`; seed restored history via `initialMessages`; localise every string via `labels`. Styles ship in the lib stylesheet (`@golden-passport/ds-patternfly/styles`) — no extra CSS import.

examples.description: The assistant docked in the app Shell: branded masthead + sidebar nav, content stage as the overlay container, and a live async onSend handler.

building-blocks-navigation-pageheader.usage: PageHeader is the standard top-of-page header: a title row (optional icon + status <Label> + right-aligned actions), an optional subtitle, a breadcrumb slot above, and a tabs strip below. Every region is a ReactNode slot — fill what you need. No labels prop (all text is caller-provided content).

building-blocks-navigation-appheader.usage: AppHeader is the branded application masthead: an optional sidebar-toggle (onToggleNav), a brand/logo slot, and a right-aligned actions slot (search, help, user menu). Composes the base Masthead family; brand styling flows from the dials. For the full page frame (masthead + sidebar + content), use Shell.

building-blocks-navigation-appfooter.usage: AppFooter is the branded site footer: an optional logo + tagline, columns of link groups (sitemap), and a bottom bar with copyright + inline legal links. Layout + brand dials only; all content is caller-provided. Each link-group renders a uniquely-labelled nav landmark.

building-blocks-forms-validatedtextfield.usage: ValidatedTextField is a labelled, validated single-line field composing base FormGroup + TextInput + HelperText. Fully controlled (own value, update from onChange); pass composable `validators` (required, minLength, email, …). Errors surface on blur (or per validateOn) with derived PF `validated` state, an error/helper message, and aria-describedby — all wired for you.

building-blocks-forms-validatedtextarea.usage: ValidatedTextArea is the multi-line sibling of ValidatedTextField: same controlled value + composable `validators` API over a base TextArea, with errors on blur, derived `validated` state, and aria-describedby. Supports rows / autoResize.

building-blocks-forms-validatedselect.usage: ValidatedSelect is a labelled, validated single-select built on the base FormSelect. Pass `options` (include a placeholder row with value ""), own `value`, and the same composable `validators`; errors surface on blur with derived `validated` state.

building-blocks-forms-formscaffold.usage: FormScaffold is the standard form frame: your fields as children, then a branded submit / cancel ActionGroup. Wires the submit handler (native submit prevented) and a disabled-submit guard, so you focus on the fields (e.g. the Validated* lego blocks). Localise the buttons via labels (formScaffoldEnLabels).

building-blocks-forms-listtransfer.usage: ListTransfer is the dual list selector: two side-by-side lists with controls for moving items between an Available pane and a Chosen pane (select-some / move-all, both directions). Controlled by the `available` + `chosen` partitions (arrays of { id, text }); ListTransfer owns the transient per-item selection + move logic and fires onChange with the new partition. Use for permissions, column pickers, allow-lists. Localise via labels (listTransferEnLabels). The friendlier wrapper over the base DualListSelector composition.

building-blocks-data-datatable.usage: DataTable is a declarative table over `columns` (DataTableColumn<T>: key/header/cell) + `rows`, with optional toolbar and pagination slots and built-in loading (spinner) / empty (slot) states. Composes the base Table family; you bring the data and the column renderers.

building-blocks-data-cardgrid.usage: CardGrid is a responsive gallery of cards from a data array: pass `items` and a `renderItem` that returns the card body; CardGrid handles the responsive Gallery layout (auto-fills columns at minColumnWidth) and an optional `emptyState`. The standard alternative to a table for browse-style collections.

building-blocks-data-filtertoolbar.usage: FilterToolbar is the fully-controlled filter bar: a search field, faceted multi-select facets (FilterDef[]), removable filter chips, and one-click clear-all. You own searchValue + values and update them from onSearchChange / onChange / onClearAll; chips and clear-all derive from values automatically. Localise chrome text via labels (filterToolbarEnLabels).

building-blocks-data-bulkselecttoolbar.usage: BulkSelectToolbar is the controlled 'select many, act on many' toolbar: a split checkbox + dropdown (select all / page / none), a derived '{n} selected' status, and bulk actions shown once a selection exists. You own the selection; pass counts + handlers. The split checkbox reflects page-selected / partially-selected state. Localise via labels (bulkSelectToolbarEnLabels).

building-blocks-data-listmanager.usage: ListManager is the layout-only page scaffold for a managed collection: header slot (PageHeader), a toolbar row (FilterToolbar + BulkSelectToolbar left via `toolbar`, Pagination right via `toolbarEnd`), the list body (children — a Table or Gallery), and a footer pagination slot. It owns the vertical rhythm and toolbar arrangement; you bring the pieces and the data.

building-blocks-data-listview.usage: ListView is a selectable list of rows from an `items` array (id/title/description?/content?/actions?), wrapping the base DataList with single-select wiring (selectedId + onSelect) and an emptyState slot. The richer sibling of the base SimpleList (multi-cell rows + per-row actions). For tabular data with columns use DataTable; for browse-style cards use CardGrid.

building-blocks-navigation-tabbedview.usage: TabbedView is a declarative tabbed container over a `tabs` array (key/title/content/isDisabled?/icon?). Renders the base Tabs strip + the active panel; manages the active tab itself (defaultActiveKey) or controlled (activeKey + onSelect). Supports isBox / isVertical.

building-blocks-navigation-treenavigatio.usage: TreeNavigation is a controlled hierarchical navigation tree from a nested `data` array of TreeNode (id/name/children?/icon?). Wraps the base TreeView, mapping your nodes to PF data items and deriving the active item from selectedId, so selection is a simple controlled string. Optional hasSearch / hasCheckboxes / hasGuides. Use for file trees, nav hierarchies, category pickers.

building-blocks-feedback-confirmmodal.usage: ConfirmModal is a small controlled confirmation dialog: title, body, and a confirm / cancel footer. Set variant="danger" for destructive actions (red confirm button). Composes the base Modal family; you own isOpen and the confirm/cancel handlers. Localise via labels (confirmModalEnLabels).

building-blocks-feedback-statuspanel.usage: StatusPanel is the one lego block for every full-panel state screen: pick a variant (empty | error | unauthorized | maintenance) which sets a sensible default icon + accent, set the title/body, and add primary/secondary actions. Composes the base EmptyState family. Drop it into DataTable/CardGrid empty slots. For a plain empty state, EmptyStatePanel is the dedicated, self-describing alias.

building-blocks-feedback-emptystatepanel.usage: EmptyStatePanel is the dedicated 'nothing here yet' empty-state lego block: an icon, a title, optional body, and a primary call-to-action (plus optional secondary actions). It's StatusPanel's `empty` variant under a self-describing name — reach for it for first-run states and no-results states (swap the icon to SearchIcon). Drop it into the emptyState slot of DataTable / CardGrid / ListView. For error / unauthorized / maintenance, use StatusPanel directly.

building-blocks-layouts-dashboardshell.usage: DashboardShell is the dashboard page scaffold: a titled header band (title + description + right-aligned actions slot) over a content region you fill with a KPI strip, charts, and status cards (children). Layout + rhythm only — chart libraries (@patternfly/react-charts, ECharts) stay in your app and never enter the design system.

building-blocks-layouts-compassshell.usage: CompassShell is the full-viewport PatternFly Compass page frame: a header band, an optional left nav rail (sidebarStart) and right rail (sidebarEnd), the main content (children), and a docked footer (the CompassMessageBar slot — e.g. an AiAssistant bar). Wraps PF6 Compass with a SkipToContent link + focusable main-content target + controlled mobile-nav drawer plumbing (drawer / isDrawerOpen / onDrawerOpenChange). Compose the base CompassHeader / CompassMessageBar / Nav into the slots. For a simpler masthead + sidebar + content layout, use Shell.
